source_state: Uncommitted accumulated tank-driving work; exact source overlay against base retained.
notes: Native physics is unchanged: torque 120, radius 0.65, existing springs/brakes, motor/support gates and route safety checks.
Candidate keeps cruise speed while lookahead grade rises over 0.08 or chassis still pitches uphill over 5 degrees, slowing other rough terrain to 1.5 and tapering speed near the goal.
A failed progress window spends one of two retries, waits three seconds, then attempts a safe four-unit retreat at up to 1.5. Rear terrain is checked every tick and retreat has a six-second deadline.
Overall best distance and retry history persist. Forward progress within a paid retry is monotonic from the completed retreat, so run-up distance is not confused with an immediate new stall.

Twenty fresh course comparisons cover both shapes, both gears and five courses. Goal arrives on flat/step/slope/returned rubble and safely refuses the trench. Rubble mostly redeposits before arrival at the pile.
Eight failure comparisons clone exact native state and existing goal history. Improved goal is compared with candidate_goal on identical corrected support. Neither world nor controller is reset.

All four old-support rejection captures recover with one actual retreat. Four later mechanical-stall captures retain the already-spent retry/pending cooldown and recover without another retreat. These outcomes are distinct.

All four retained old-support comparisons exactly reproduce initial native snapshots/observations/goal history and all six final hashes. --reference-goal retains the original policy in the driving runner.
Goal driving is selectable in playable courses; normal combat retains the range policy. Driver/manual switches preserve goal/retry state, while Reset/course changes explicitly start fresh.
All 26 existing benchmarks conserve material, pass replay and retain their previous observation hashes. Incidental timing is not a performance claim.
No source changes were made after the final manifest other than documentation. No commit or PR created.
